text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having been through so many races with
Mejiro
Ardan, this moment right now
feels like some sort
of milestone for us...
Such are the thoughts going
through my
head one day, when—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pardon my intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, may I consult you for advice?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This concerns our future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We won the grand prize of a hot springs
vacation
for two at a raffle a short while
ago—perhaps you
remember?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I believe the tickets are in your
possession, and I
wished to speak with
you about our future plans
regarding this
vacation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since this moment in time serves as
something of
a milestone, I believe I can
allow myself to get
into the mood for a
vacation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: How do you feel about it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well, it's rather a simple question.
choice_data_list: 'As for me'... what do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go on vacation
together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Let me rephrase that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let's go on vacation together. This is my number one wish as of right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Mejiro Ardan's trainer, there's no way
I can
refuse her "number one wish."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We settle on a date, make the necessary

preparations, and then, before we know
it, the
day is upon us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... That was a delightful bath. This
must be
what it means to feel cleansed
in both body and
soul.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...It appears that we still have some time
before
the meal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that the inn is beside the sea.
Shall we
take a walk?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What a lovely breeze...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, thank you ever so much for

accompanying me on this trip today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...The very notion of going away on a
trip and
letting loose like this would
have been
unthinkable for the old me.
choice_data_list: Thank you as well for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I must spend my now on the turf, doing what I ought to. "I must live my life as if running across the thin ice of a frozen lake, never stopping to relax for a moment."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...That's what I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But now, things are different.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This trip today... has been very fun
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The sights I'm seeing, the things I'm
learning for
the first time, the idle
chitchat, all of it... The
dazzling light of
each and every moment has been

impressed upon my heart...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I've come to love the moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It hadn't occurred to me... that living in
the
moment could bring such tranquility.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...But I'm not the only one working hard.
Far from
it.
choice_data_list: It's definitely because of all the hard work you've put in until today, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because you were there
with me that
I was able to find my way to
this moment... That's
what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we start making our way back?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Although our vacation has yet to end, a
part of
me is already wishing to set off
on another trip
someday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This is a little embarrassing, but there
are simply
so many places I wish to visit
that if I were to start
listing them, I
doubt I'd ever be able to stop.
choice_data_list: Where do you want to go, for instance?
Where would you like to go, for example?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But if I were pressed to offer an answer...
I'm
rather fascinated by the thought of
traveling
overseas. I would very much
like to see some
historical locales and
scenic sights.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Europe would be fantastic, as would
China. I think
Beijing in particular would
be full of places to see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I shall have to live quite a long
life in order
to complete my checklist.
choice_data_list: At this point, we've got no choice but to do them all.
Guess there's nothing for it but to tackle them all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When the opportunity presents itself,
would you
like to go on vacation
together again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I expect... it will turn out to be a moment
in time
even more exciting than today's.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry, let me rephrase that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let's go on vacation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Just the two of us again, someday...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that during our time together,
Mejiro
Ardan and I have formed an
irreplaceable bond...
